info.name: Dealing with Boss Kitty
info.parent: Sakura, the Kitty, and the Orange Marble

descriptions.notStarted: Now I must try to talk with the Boss Kitty to propose a deal for that Orange Marble...
descriptions.inProgress: I could understand what the Boss Kitty said, but in order to regain #bOrange Marble#k, I'll have to perform a task first.
descriptions.completed: I'll have to answer every single question fired by the Boss Kitty right. Not only that, in order to even start the quiz, it'll require #b300 Fried Chickens#k. Crazy...I know cats love birds, but that's ridiculous...
